name: In 2025,
tagline: Daniel & Anna's Orchard, 5116 North Freetown Road, New Iberia, LA (2026)
description: In New Iberia, LA, In 2025, raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Blackberries, Pears, and Peaches on a independent farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
